pokemon_scp.name: Lapras
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0131 is to be housed in a deep aquatic chamber with controlled temperature gradients. SCP-0131 may assist Foundation personnel in aquatic rescue operations under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0131 is a large aquatic organism capable of generating harmonic vocalizations that calm nearby organisms and stabilize emotional states. Ice generation occurs through dermal nodes along its shell.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Gentle and empathetic. Shows protective behavior toward distressed personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0131-A: SCP-0131’s vocalization neutralized a panic event in Containment Wing C.
Addendum 0131-B: Ice generation formed fractal patterns resembling snowflakes.

pokemon_scp.name: Ditto
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0132 is to be contained in a polymorph-resistant vault with identity verification protocols. Personnel must undergo biometric scans before and after interaction.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0132 is an amorphous organism capable of perfectly mimicking the appearance and physical properties of any organism it observes. Imperfect replications occasionally display distorted facial features.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Unpredictable. Attempts to mimic personnel to escape containment.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0132-A: SCP-0132 replicated a Level-3 researcher and bypassed two security checkpoints.
Addendum 0132-B: Imperfect mimicry produced a distorted copy with asymmetrical eyes.

pokemon_scp.name: Eevee
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0133 is to be contained in a mammalian chamber with genetic monitoring equipment. Personnel may interact with SCP-0133 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0133 possesses unstable genetic structure capable of rapid adaptation. Genetic markers shift unpredictably, suggesting multiple potential evolutionary pathways.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly and curious. Shows attachment to familiar personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0133-A: Genetic scan revealed seven simultaneous evolutionary markers.
Addendum 0133-B: SCP-0133’s fur changed color during emotional stress.

pokemon_scp.name: Vaporeon
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0134 is to be contained in a mid-depth aquatic vault with hydration monitoring. Personnel must avoid exposure to SCP-0134’s molecular diffusion.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0134 can dissolve its body into water, becoming partially intangible. Reformation occurs within seconds. Displays advanced hydrokinesis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm and elusive. Frequently dissolves into water when startled.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0134-A: SCP-0134 diffused into containment water to avoid capture.
Addendum 0134-B: Hydrokinesis formed water constructs resembling humanoid shapes.

pokemon_scp.name: Jolteon
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0135 is to be contained in a reinforced Faraday vault with static discharge grounding. Personnel must wear insulated suits.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0135’s fur generates constant static buildup capable of releasing lightning-like discharges. Spines can be electrified and launched as projectiles.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Agitated and reactive. Electrical output spikes during stress.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0135-A: SCP-0135 launched electrified spines that disabled a containment drone.
Addendum 0135-B: Static buildup exceeded 80,000 volts during testing.

pokemon_scp.name: Flareon
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0136 is to be contained in a heat-shielded vault with flame-dampening systems. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 15 meters.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0136’s internal temperature exceeds 1,500°C. Fur emits constant heat waves capable of igniting nearby materials. Displays rapid combustion bursts when agitated.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but volatile. Heat output increases with emotional intensity.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0136-A: SCP-0136 ignited containment padding during a stress event.
Addendum 0136-B: Thermal scans show internal flame sacs.

pokemon_scp.name: Porygon
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0137 is to be contained in a digital-interference vault with EM shielding. Personnel must avoid connecting SCP-0137 to external networks.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0137 is a digital-organic hybrid capable of converting its body into data and entering electronic systems. Displays polygonal morphology and emits low-frequency digital noise.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Curious and analytical. Attempts to interface with nearby electronics.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0137-A: SCP-0137 entered a containment computer and altered system logs.
Addendum 0137-B: Digital noise resembles corrupted binary sequences.

pokemon_scp.name: Omanyte
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0138 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic fossil chamber. Personnel may interact with SCP-0138 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0138 is a revived fossil organism with a spiral shell. Displays mild hydrokinesis and slow locomotion.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and curious. Frequently retracts into its shell when startled.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0138-A: SCP-0138’s shell resisted high-pressure compression.
Addendum 0138-B: Hydrokinesis formed small spiraling water currents.

pokemon_scp.name: Omastar
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0139 is to be contained in a reinforced aquatic vault. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0139’s tentacles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0139 possesses powerful tentacles capable of crushing reinforced materials. Shell shows anomalous density and regenerative properties.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when hungry. Attempts to ensnare nearby objects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0139-A: SCP-0139 crushed a containment drone.
Addendum 0139-B: Shell regeneration occurred in under 12 hours.

pokemon_scp.name: Kabuto
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0140 is to be contained in a fossil-grade aquatic chamber with low lighting. Personnel must avoid startling SCP-0140.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0140 is a revived fossil organism with a hardened carapace and bioluminescent eyes. Displays rapid scuttling movement and mild hydrokinesis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Skittish and reactive. Frequently hides beneath rocks.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0140-A: SCP-0140’s carapace resisted industrial drilling tools.
Addendum 0140-B: Eye bioluminescence intensified during stress.
